telem_smoke.note: pytest -m integration passed two live Telem searches. An earlier call with no API key returned AuthError HTTP 401 and no results.

story_a.question: How do NVIDIA's investments, GPU infrastructure customers, and AI capacity expansion reinforce one another?
story_a.notes: Measured from one fresh-cache run. Telem search used brave and tavily. One Telem fetch read 5 URLs. The first LLM call raised ReadTimeout; remaining pages were not sent to the model. No relationships were invented. Resume reused the five cached documents and made no further network fetches. Token and dollar fields are null because the API did not return them.

story_c.question: Do three articles independently substantiate a company's claim?
story_c.notes: Story C uses the local four-document fixture. The B3 search_calls value is the one local follow-up, not a Telem call. B0 does not reconcile the $480 million sentence, so it stays supported by its own quotation. B3 marks that sentence contradicted by the original $400 million announcement. Sample size is one investigation.
